sentences.text:
1 5. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Naeem with the following prayers:
"It is, therefore, Most Respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to allow this application and quash the Charge sheet no.83 of 2020 dated 20.03.2020 and cognizance/summoning order dated 09.10.2020 in Case No. 1294/10/20 (State Vs. Naeem), under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station- Kotwali,
District-Mathura arising out of Case Crime No.25 of 2020, pending before the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-I, Mathura.

It is further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to stay the Charge sheet no.83 of 2020 dated 20.03.2020 and cognizance/summoning order dated 09.10.2020 in Case No. 1294/10/20 (State Vs. Naeem), under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station- Kotwali, District- Mathura arising out of Case Crime No.25 of 2020, pending before the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-I, Mathura during pendency of the present matter and/or to pass such other and further order protecting the interest of the applicant, which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case, so that justice may be done."
6.

After arguments at length, learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant be granted time to surrender before the trial court and appropriate directions be issued to the trial court to decide his bail application, expeditiously.

7. The records show that after being granted interim anticipatory bail vide order dated 17.02.2020 and the case was then dismissed for non prosecution on 04.07.2022 and the interim order was vacated but the applicant then had absconded and till date he is absconding and it is about 1 year and 9 months.
8.

In view of the same, no specific direction for considering the bail application of the applicant expeditiously is needed, however, the concerned trial court shall decide the same in accordance with law if the applicant appears/surrenders before the concerned trial court within two weeks from toady.
9. The present application is disposed of.
